doc.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001

title: Sonny Rollins as a hero
summary: He never met Rollins but admired the 1960s Rollins and the way he handled pop songs.

story.theme_name: Playing with Coltrane and the avant-garde

blocks.x: Wow. He’s a very unique guy.
Yeah, he was one of my real heroes, and remains that way.
Yeah. He has such a way of interpreting songs and finding the —

Well it’s the old Sonny Rollins. I’m talking about the Sonny Rollins of the 1960s maybe that really got to me. The newer stuff I haven’t paid much attention to. But the way he handled pop songs, like you said, that really got to me. I loved it. That was a mind at work that I really was interested in there.
